about_the_game:
Grab your skis (or snowboard) and enjoy a day in the mountains! Compete in challenges, try activities like paragliding, ziplining, and speed skiing, or relax and carve your own path down the mountain. The choice is yours in this snowy open-world adventure!

HUGE OPEN-WORLD SKI RESORTS

Explore massive ski resorts with busy slopes, deep forests, steep cliffs, untouched backcountry, and lively Après Skis. Ride the lifts, explore the pistes, or head off-piste to discover secret spots. The mountains are non-linear, giving you the freedom to explore anywhere.

HUNDREDS OF UNIQUE CHALLENGES

Test your skills in a wide range of challenges like slalom, big air, slopestyle, downhill racing, and ski jumping. The challenges are easy to learn but hard to master, with an extreme Double-Diamond difficulty for the daring.

SPECIAL ACTIVITIES AND MODES

From paragliding and ziplining to longboarding and speedskiing, the mountain is packed with extra activities and special modes like 2D platformer, and top-down skiing.

GEAR AND CLOTHES

Purchase new gear and clothing and customize your look. And unlock unique clothing by completing difficult challenges.

TRICKS, COMBOS AND TRANSITIONS

Combine spins, flips, rodeos, grabs, boxes, rails, and transitions for impressive trick combos. Master advanced moves like nose/tail presses or tapping trees with your ski tip for epic multipliers.

REALISTIC MOUNTAIN SIMULATOR

Dynamic weather, skiers that ski around on their own, changing mountain conditions, and elements like wind, snowfall, day-night cycles, avalanches, and rolling rocks.

ZEN MODE

Turn on Zen Mode to enjoy a distraction-free powder day. No pesky lift-queues, busy slopes  or challenges to interrupt your flow. Get a whole ski resort for yourself!

INTUITIVE CONTROLS

Simple, intuitive controls and game controller support!

About Toppluva

Grand Mountain Adventure 2 is made by three snowboarding brothers from Sweden: Viktor, Sebastian, and Alexander. This is our second game in the popular Grand Mountain Adventure series, played by over 20 million players worldwide. We make everything in the game ourselves and our goal is to make this sequel bigger, better, stronger, more fun, more magical, and more everything for winter sports fans like us.
